text: The place is great for picture taking as it has over the top Chinese decoration. It was crowded. Eventhough my cousin had already reserved a table for 7 pm we still had to wait for 15 min for a table. The menu was extensive. They had sauce mixing station for 3 types of sauce. We had crab hot pot and Tứ Xuyên hot pot. The Tứ Xuyên hot pot was extremely spicy. Wish I had ordered the mushroom one instead. We ordered the Waygu beef, Australian beef and other dishes. The beef was extra thin for hot pot and only a few slices. The dumplings were ok. The staff did tell us that a dumpling order only has 4 instead of 8 dumplings as pictured in the menu. We put in another order for dumplings. Waited and reminded the cute waitress after 20 minutes. She went to check and came back to tell us they ran out but nobody told her. We ordered multiple dishes, the table could not hold them all. The dirty dishes piled up on the table and the side table but nobody came to remove them until we asked specifically for them to be removed. Over all, the restaurant is great as a novelty. The price is higher than average. The quality is good. Service, when we could get them, was polite and reactive.

text:
餐點有做到該有的水準品質了。
這次來用餐點了4種湯底，不管麻辣或者起司口味，湯頭都有忠實的表現出來應有的滋味，跟附近很多其他沒味道的火鍋店確實有差距。
肉類是相當新鮮，沾料一應俱全。如果目標是招待客人的話，這裡真的是很不錯的選擇。
但是缺點就是價位真的太高了，連我都覺得這樣的量收這個價格真的有點偏貴。對於想要大量過癮吃肉的人來說，還是建議考慮附近其他吃到飽火鍋店比較划算。
這裡有一個產品我真的要推薦，就是炒飯，炒出來的米粒有種很不可思議的Q彈，我一度認為是小麥或者小薏仁，但是店家堅持就是一般白米。我不信，請店家拿米粒讓我看，拿出來的米粒竟然真的就只是白米。很難想像廚師是怎樣處理這炒飯，能炒出這種粒粒分明，咀嚼留香彈牙的爽感，真的建議要點一份來試試看。
如果有人知道原因的話，也希望可以分享一下讓我解除我的迷惑。

Món ăn đạt tiêu chuẩn chất lượng như mong đợi.

Lần này chúng tôi gọi bốn loại nước dùng khác nhau, và dù là cay hay vị phô mai, nước dùng đều giữ đúng hương vị vốn có, một điểm khác biệt đáng kể so với nhiều nhà hàng lẩu nhạt nhẽo khác trong khu vực.

text:
We came here for dinner recently. I'm not usually a fan of hotpot so I didn't really expect much. My son wanted to try it. Our family of 3 ordered a 4 pot variation. My family ordered the "mala" but since I'm not a fan, we also got the original, mushroom, and pickled vegetables versions.

I'm not a red meat eater but my family is so they got beef, tongue as well as bone marrow, and blood cubes. I got some shrimp, fish paste with dill, and lots of vegetables.

The fish paste with dill was my favorite. In fact, I got another order. The fish balls with roe was delicious also.

There's a condiment bar where you can make your own dipping sauce. There were a few items that we're familiar with that wasn't offered: sesame sauce (although they had sesame seeds), dark vinegar, sate sauce (there was XO sauce).

I really enjoyed this meal and look forward to coming back and trying other varieties of "pastes" which all come in a "bamboo" tube.
